title: Hal Puthoff ordered copies of UFOs and Nukes to give out in Washington

tellings.quote: when the first edition of UFOs and nukes came out he suddenly wrote to me and said I need four copies of the book shipped overnight

plain: When the first edition of UFOs and Nukes came out, the physicist Hal Puthoff suddenly wrote to its author asking for four copies shipped overnight, to hand out to people in Washington. UFOs and Nukes is a book about unidentified craft seen near nuclear weapons sites, and the researcher Robert Hastings, who wrote it, tells this from his own experience. He tells it as a sign that his book was reaching people in government, years before a New York Times article in December 2017 revealed a secret Pentagon UFO study.
